evidence: Initializes the audio subsystem state, calls the scream audio configuration routine, and passes the exact Bink Audio label (0x7001c7d3ac) through the audio setup helper. Invoked from startup initialization at main_0000.c:5230. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0030.c:48152-48306; main_0000.c:5230.

Builds a formatted attribute/context description using the exact `%s%s in the %s` template (0x7001c4ce9b), context status lookups, and a caller that consumes the generated status record in the same attribute flow. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0104.c:12944-13171; caller main_0104.c:11352.

Initializes the named memory region `CareerDecisionView Pool` (0x7001cdd7ee), allocates and initializes its view-pool records, and runs the associated pool setup helpers. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0035.c:40395-40502, especially :40411-40453.

Initializes the named memory region `StatView Pool` (0x7001cdfd94), allocates the associated pool storage, and initializes its records. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0089.c:5288-5340, especially :5302-5324.

Initializes the named memory region `AllStarVotingView Pool` (0x7001c5481c), sets up a large repeated set of pool entries, and continues into the pool constructor at f_7000cae600. No indexed direct caller was found. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0087.c:25225-25382, especially :25351-25382.

Checks several current mode/context slots, then resolves the exact `DiamondDynasty` label (0x7001d45fa5) and passes the result through a context-state helper. Caller main_0034.c:18139 stores and uses the returned status in the mode-specific flow. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0065.c:34538-34589; main_0034.c:18125-18145.

Processes an attribute-context request, checks context state, invokes player-attribute float/category adjustment helpers, and updates the attribute context before returning the result. Caller main_0056.c:3806 invokes it while processing an attribute display/value path. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0171.c:26141-26500; main_0056.c:3785-3815.

Initializes a named memory region using the exact `AssetBinder` label (0x7001d4bf09) and performs allocation and registration/setup for the asset-binder pool. Caller main_0033.c:55107 invokes it during binder initialization. Sources: decompiled/main/main_0172.c:26178-26379; main_0033.c:55107.
